spans.s: (इळा—दध इडा—दध, and इला—दध), n. N. of a particular Iṣṭy-ayana or sacrificial observance, AitBr.; ĀśvŚr.
इला—दध m. N. of a particular sacrifice, ĀśvŚr. &c.
See इडा-दध.
इला. See इड, इ॑डा, p. 164, col. 2, and इ॑ला below.
(closely connected with इ॑डा and इ॑रा, qq.v.) flow
speech
the earth, &c.
See इडा.
(इळव, Sāy.) m. a ploughman, boor, AitBr. v, 3, 5.
= इडविड, q.v. N. of a son of Daśaratha
N. of a daughter of Tṛṇa-bindu (wife of Viśravas and mother of Kuvera), VP.
इला—गोल n. the earth, globe, L.
इला—तल n. the fourth place in the circle of the zodiac
the surface of the earth.
इला—दुर्ग n. N. of a place.
इ॑ला—˚ं-द इ॑लां-द), n. (‘granting refreshment or food’
N. of a Sāman, MaitrS.; TāṇḍyaBr.; Lāṭy. &c.
इ॑ला˚वृत m. N. of a son of Āgnīdhra (who received the Varṣa Ilāvṛta as his kingdom)
इला—˚वृत n. one of the nine Varṣas or divisions of the known world (comprehending the highest and most central part of the old continent, cf. वर्ष), MBh.; BhP.; MārkP.; VP. &c.
इला—सुता f. N. of Sītā.
